summary: Bandai Namco's long-running action JRPG series, covering the seventeen mainline Tales entries and their major modern remasters/definitive releases.

entries.title: Tales of Phantasia

primary.version: Tales of Phantasia: Full Voice Edition / PSP route
primary.why: Phantasia has multiple later ports after the Super Famicom original; the PSP Full Voice line is the most complete high-fidelity legacy route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version with PPSSPP at increased internal resolution; use GBA only if official English is required.

secondary.what_to_play: Use the GBA version only if official English text is required.
secondary.why: The PSP versions were not the official Western release, while the GBA version was localized.

entries.remaster_caveats: No current official PC/console remaster identified.

emulation.notes: Use PS2 emulation with increased internal resolution.

primary.why: The PS2 remake/Director's Cut is the most complete and highest-fidelity route for Destiny.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Destiny Director's Cut with PCSX2 at increased internal resolution.

secondary.what_to_play: Use the PlayStation release if official English is required.
secondary.why: The PS2 remake/Director's Cut was not the official Western release.

entries.title: Tales of Eternia

primary.why: Eternia's later PSP release is the highest-fidelity portable route; the PlayStation version remains the official North American Tales of Destiny II route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version with PPSSPP at increased internal resolution.

secondary.exclusive_content: Official North American localization under the title Tales of Destiny II.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the PlayStation version if the official North American script/release context matters.
secondary.why: The PSP route is the later version, while the PS1 release is the original localized route.

entries.remaster_caveats: A later remaster has not been officially sourced in this pass.

entries.title: Tales of Destiny 2

emulation.notes: Use PPSSPP for the PSP route or PCSX2 for PS2 comparison.

primary.why: The Japan-only true sequel to Destiny was released on PS2 and later PSP; PSP emulation is the cleanest modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version with PPSSPP, or use PCSX2 for the original PS2 release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japan/Asia-only title; do not confuse it with North America's renamed Tales of Eternia.

entries.title: Tales of Symphonia

emulation.notes: Use native Windows; Dolphin only for original GameCube comparison.

primary.why: Symphonia has GameCube, PS2, PS3, PC, and later remastered console routes; Windows provides the highest configurable fidelity for the content-complete post-PS2/Chronicles line.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Symphonia on Windows/Steam with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remastered console editions are useful, but PC remains the configurable route.

primary.why: Rebirth was released for PS2 and later PSP; PSP emulation provides the cleanest modern route for the later version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version with PPSSPP; use PCSX2 only for PS2 comparison.

primary.why: Legendia is a PS2 mainline entry with no later enhanced port identified; PCSX2 provides the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Legendia with PCSX2 at increased internal resolution.

entries.title: Tales of the Abyss

primary.why: Abyss shipped on PS2 and later 3DS; PS2 emulation offers the highest visual ceiling for the original console version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of the Abyss with PCSX2 at increased internal resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: 3DS is portable but not the fidelity pick.

emulation.notes: Prefer original Vita hardware if compatibility is an issue.

primary.why: Innocence R is the later Vita remake of the DS game and is the most complete/highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Innocence R on Vita hardware or a compatible preservation setup.

entries.title: Tales of Vesperia

primary.why: The Definitive Edition includes content from the Japanese PS3 version and released on PC and modern consoles; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Vesperia: Definitive Edition on Windows/Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Xbox 360 and PS3 releases are historical routes only.

emulation.notes: Prefer original Vita hardware if compatibility is an issue.

primary.why: Hearts R is the Vita remake and official localized route, making it the preferred version.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Hearts R on Vita hardware or a compatible preservation setup.

primary.why: Graces f is the expanded version, and the 2025 remaster brings it to PC and modern consoles; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Graces f Remastered on Windows/Steam.

primary.why: The 2025 remaster brings Xillia to PC and modern consoles with new visuals/features and included original DLC packs; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Xillia Remastered on Windows/Steam.

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware or RPCS3 where compatible.

primary.why: Xillia 2 remains a PS3 release with no sourced modern remaster in this pass; RPCS3 or original hardware provides the best route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Xillia 2 on PS3 hardware or RPCS3 where compatible.

primary.why: Zestiria released on PS3, PS4, and Windows; Windows is the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Zestiria on Windows/Steam.

primary.why: The 2026 remaster released for PC and modern consoles; Windows is the highest-fidelity current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Berseria Remastered on Windows/Steam.

entries.title: Tales of Arise
entries.definitive_edition: Beyond the Dawn Edition / PC release

primary.version: Beyond the Dawn Edition / PC release
primary.why: Arise's Beyond the Dawn edition includes the base game and expansion content; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tales of Arise on Windows/Steam with the Beyond the Dawn expansion or premium edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the expansion or edition that includes Beyond the Dawn for the complete route.
